message.content: Yes, Li Hua did engage with Jennifer before seeking her opinion on protein supplements. Initially, Li Hua reached out to Jennifer with a question about his overall protein powder intake in relation to his fitness goals. Jennifer provided guidance on the general protein intake recommendation of 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kg of body weight and emphasized the importance of considering protein from food sources. Following this advice, Li Hua specifically asked Jennifer for her opinion on the best type of protein supplement to support his fitness objectives. Jennifer then recommended whey protein for muscle recovery and building lean mass, and also mentioned plant-based alternatives like pea or rice protein, advising Li Hua to check for added sugars or fillers in the products. This sequence of interactions shows Li Hua's progression from a general inquiry about protein powder servings to seeking advice on the selection of a suitable protein supplement.
